verdict.rationale: Radar offers indirect ways to act on many items at once. Rules apply automatically to all matching payments (e.g., request 3DS for all new customers, block out-of-country cards). Value lists group values that rules can reference, and a targeted review queue avoids reviewing each payment individually. However, the only documented review action is per-item (POST /v1/reviews/:id/approve), and nothing shows a batch endpoint or multi-select bulk action. Missing for 10: a documented bulk/batch API or Dashboard bulk action for reviews, lists or payments; bulk operations via the CLI or MCP server; independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
